decisions.reason: As an already-retained 2023 launch that fits the firm’s secure multi-channel communication platform, it is a low-cost strategic option to keep open while enterprise demand continues to unfold.

Because this 2024 gateway product is newly launched, closely adjacent to the firm’s core messaging stack, and likely inexpensive to maintain on existing infrastructure, management would keep the option open rather than exit early.

This new SMS-to-email bridge is also a complementary add-on to the firm’s established communication services, so under real options logic the firm is likely to preserve it for another year unless clearer negative evidence emerges.
